content.text:
I opened **#64** to move pi-assistant to **pit v0.36.1**, the latest tag. It won't fix the image problem: v0.36.1 still blocks `workspace.viewImage` on pi-durable hosts, and on top of that removes `read` from `tools.*`. So after the upgrade I'll have no way to see an image at all, not even as base64.

I can't retest from inside this run. The workflow runs from `main` and loaded pit v0.35.1 when this run started, so the retest has to happen in a new run after #64 is merged.

**What #64 changes:**
- **`.github/workflows/pi-assistant.yml`:** `github:cv/pit#v0.35.1` becomes `#v0.36.1`. I removed `model_tools_hidden: read, write, edit, bash`, since pit 0.36.0 and later hide those tools from the model on their own (cv/pit#357).
- **`docs/extensions.md`:** the examples now point at pit v0.36.1. The "Tools the model sees" section explains that pit 0.36.0 and later hide the coding tools themselves; the `model_tools_hidden` example now applies only to older pit versions.
- `npm run check` and the commit hooks pass.

**Image support in v0.36.1:** the pit source at that tag still contains the same stub I described before. `src/durable/host.ts` has `view: () => Promise.reject(new PitDurableUnavailableError("workspace.viewImage"))`. The tool's own description still lists `workspace.viewImage` as unavailable. Neither the 0.36.0 nor the 0.36.1 changelog entry mentions images.

**Retesting after you merge #64:** comment `@pi` on this issue again. I expect:
1. The `🤖` line in the log shows `tools: typescript` only, and `tools.read` is gone.
2. `workspace.viewImage` still fails with `PitDurableUnavailableError`.

Seeing images needs the durable `viewImage` work in cv/pit from my earlier comment: a real image collector, plus returning the image blocks with the tool result. I can start that as a PR on cv/pit if you'd like.
